name: Awakening of the Sun
main_effect:
[Main] You may play 1 [Marcus Damon] or [Rhythm] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When one of your Tamers is deleted or returned to the hand, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [ShineGreymon] in its name in the hand without paying the cost.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 card with [Marcus Damon] or [Rhythm] in its name from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
